image_description: A close-up, slightly low-angle shot of a large common iguana perched on a thick branch or log. The iguana is facing left, with its head resting near the end of the branch. Its skin appears textured and greyish-green, likely due to lighting or age, rather than bright juvenile green. A prominent dorsal crest runs down its neck and back. The forelimbs are visible gripping the branch, showing long digits. The background is a blurry, rocky enclosure wall, suggesting a zoo or terrarium setting. There is a vertical reflection or glass edge on the right side.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail extends out of the frame or is heavily occluded by the body/branch. Only the base is potentially visible, making full assessment impossible.
